intro: Returning, exchanging and asking about the warranty, discounts, fabrics and online orders.
p.garantía.consejo: The accent splits i-a: ga-ran-TÍ-a. You ask: «¿tiene garantía?».
p.devolver.consejo: It changes o to ue: «devuelvo». The participle is irregular: «devuelto».
p.estar de oferta.consejo: It is said about a product: «está de oferta». The offer lasts a short time.
p.descuento.consejo: It comes from «descontar». You say «un descuento del veinte por ciento».
p.tique.consejo: It comes from English «ticket», but it is written «tique». The plural is «tiques».
p.vuelta.consejo: With another sense, «la vuelta» is coming back. With money: «aquí tiene la vuelta».
p.pasar por caja.consejo: It is said in shops and supermarkets: «pase por caja». The j sounds h: KA-ha.
p.algodón.consejo: It comes from Arabic. The stress is at the end and has an accent: al-go-DÓN.
p.lana.consejo: A wool jumper keeps you very warm. It is feminine: «la lana».
p.de rayas.consejo: It is always plural: «de rayas». The y sounds as in «yo».
p.de cuadros.consejo: It is always plural: «de cuadros». It comes from «cuadro», a square.
p.liso.consejo: It agrees: «camisa lisa», «pantalón liso». It also means smooth and without wrinkles.
p.caducado.consejo: It comes from «caducar». You should not eat an expired yogurt.
p.pedido.consejo: It comes from «pedir». «Hacer un pedido» means ordering products.
b1.texto:
Before buying you can ask: **¿Tiene garantía?**, **¿Está de oferta?**, **¿Hacen algún descuento?**

Afterwards you can **devolver** a product or exchange it for another. Keep the **tique**: it is the proof of purchase. When you go to the till (**pasar por caja**) they give you the **vuelta**, the money left over.

Clothes are described with **de**: una camisa **de algodón**, un jersey **de lana**. And with the pattern: **de rayas**, **de cuadros** or **lisa**.

Expired food (**caducada**) should no longer be eaten. If you buy online you make a **pedido**.
b2.f0.texto: I would like to return this wool jacket.
b2.f4.texto: Do you want us to exchange it for another one?
b2.f5.texto: I prefer that you give me my money back.
b2.f6.texto: At the till they will give you the money back.
b2.f7.texto: Are the striped shirts on offer?
b2.f8.texto: They have a twenty per cent discount.
b2.f9.texto: Do those shirts have a warranty?
b4.texto:
The material is said with **de**: una camisa **de algodón**, un jersey **de lana**.

The pattern too: una falda **de rayas**, una chaqueta **de cuadros**. And if it has no pattern, it is **lisa** or **liso**.

The adjective agrees with the garment: una camisa lisa · unos pantalones lisos.

With **estar** we talk about the state of the product: el yogur **está caducado**, la camisa **está de oferta**.

To offer a solution: **¿Quiere que se lo cambiemos?** (**que** + subjunctive)
b4.e0.texto: A cotton shirt is very cool.
b5.f0.texto: The clothes shop opens its doors with a tinkle of little bells.
b5.f1.texto: On the hangers hang thick wool jumpers and white cotton shirts.
b5.f2.texto: A golden light falls over the striped skirts and the checked jackets.
b5.f3.texto: Julia runs her fingers over a soft fabric and stops.
b5.f4.texto: A red sign announces big discounts in huge letters.
b5.f5.texto: At the counter, the shop assistant carefully puts the receipt in a drawer.
b5.f6.texto: The new jacket still smells of clean fabric and tissue paper.
b5.f7.texto: Julia steps out into the street with a light bag and a calm smile.
b5.f8.texto: Next to the shop, a delicatessen offers thin slices of ham.
b5.f9.texto: Julia looks at her watch and decides to eat something before going home.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! The material is said with «de»: de algodón, de lana.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «En» shows place. The material is said with «de».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Con» would mean «together with» cotton. For the material you use «de».
b6.pregunta: You say what material it is made of. What is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes! Caducado means with the use-by date passed.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Liso» means plain or smooth. It does not talk about the date.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «De oferta» is about the price, not about the date.
b7.pregunta: The yogurt has a past date. What is its state?
b8.frase: Quería devolver esta chaqueta de lana
b8.traduccion: I would like to return this wool jacket
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Devuelven» is indicative. After «prefiero que» comes the subjunctive.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done! «Prefiero que» asks for the subjunctive: que me devuelvan.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Here the subject changes (they), and the infinitive does not work.
b9.pregunta: You would rather get your money back. Which form is missing?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «Does it have a warranty?»
b11.o0.refuerzo: The tique is the paper that proves the purchase, not the money.
b11.o1.refuerzo: The garantía is a promise of repair, not money.
b11.o2.refuerzo: Well done! The vuelta is the money returned to you when you pay.
b11.pregunta: You pay and get the leftover money back. What is it called?
b12.o0.refuerzo: That's it! «Camisa» is feminine singular: lisa.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Lisas» is plural, and here there is only one shirt.
b12.pregunta: It agrees with «camisa». Which form is missing?
p.chaqueta.consejo: The ch sounds as in «chocolate» and the qu sounds k: cha-KE-ta. It is feminine.
p.pedí.consejo: Past form of «pedir» for «yo». The accent shows the stress: pe-DÍ.
p.lisa.consejo: Feminine of «liso». It agrees with «camisa» or «chaqueta».
p.internet.consejo: It is written in lowercase in Spanish: «internet». «Por internet» means online.
p.llegado.consejo: Participle of «llegar». The ll sounds y: ye-GA-do. With «haber» it does not change.
p.cambiemos.consejo: Subjunctive of «cambiar» for «nosotros», after «quiere que». «Cambiar por» means to exchange for.
p.devuelvan.consejo: Subjunctive of «devolver», after «prefiero que»: «que me devuelvan el dinero».
p.devuelven.consejo: Form of «devolver» for «ellos». In «le devuelven el dinero» the subject is understood.
p.esas.consejo: Feminine plural of «ese». It goes before the noun: «esas camisas».
p.yogur.consejo: The y sounds as in «yo» and the stress is at the end: yo-GUR. The plural is «yogures».
p.tintineo.consejo: It comes from the verb «tintinear». The «eo» are two syllables: tin-ti-NE-o.
p.campanillas.consejo: The singular is «la campanilla», from «campana». The ll sounds y: kam-pa-NI-yas.
p.perchas.consejo: The ch sounds as in «chocolate». The singular is «la percha».
p.jerséis.consejo: The j sounds h. The plural of «jersey» is «jerséis», with an accent: her-SEIS.
p.faldas.consejo: The singular is «la falda». The d is soft: FAL-das.
p.chaquetas.consejo: Plural of «chaqueta». The ch sounds like the ch in «church».
p.anuncia.consejo: From «anunciar». The ci sounds like th, as in «think».
p.descuentos.consejo: The cu before e sounds like «kwe». The stress is in the middle.
p.enormes.consejo: Plural of «enorme». The stress is on «nor».
p.charcutería.consejo: The tilde on the í splits «ría» into two syllables.
p.lonchas.consejo: The ch is soft, like «ch» in «church». Stress the first syllable.
p.finas.consejo: Plural of «fino». Say «FI-nas» with clear i and n.
p.jamón.consejo: The j sounds like a soft English h. Stress the last syllable.
p.dibujos.consejo: Plural of «dibujo». The j sounds like h.
